title: Runtime weekly: Kernel selection sync notes (Auto-selection v2)
content:
Doc intent: running weekly notes for kernel auto-selection v2 (table-driven registry + scheduler signals + telemetry + rollout). This is the scratchpad we keep open during the Tue sync.

Standing agenda
- Wins/blockers since last week
- PR/Linear status scan (merge queue / release train)
- Perf/correctness readout (bench + canary)
- Observability (metrics cardinality, dashboards, trace annotations)
- Rollout plan & guardrails
- Decisions + action items

------------------------------------------------------------
2026-01-07 (Wed) 10:00–10:45 PT
Attendees: Grace, Yuki, Omar, Lena, Hiro, Sofia, Marcus, Rina
Context: Phase 0 kickoff + taxonomy/inputs alignment.

Notes
- Agreement: selector v2 should be table-driven first; heuristics only as a fallback layer (not the primary driver).
- Inputs we MUST have in selection context:
  - model family + key flags (GQA/MQA, head dim where relevant)
  - seq regime: prefill vs decode + effective sequence length bucket (needs scheduler cooperation)
  - GPU normalized SKU (L4/A10/A100/H100) + SM capability
- Open question: how to treat MIG/partitioned envs. Yuki: normalize to “effective SKU” with a field for partitioning (for debugging), but selection table keys remain the main SKUs.

Action items
- Noah to propose initial model-family taxonomy list + mapping rules (Linear ENG-3922).
- Omar/Lena to draft minimal interface changes to pass seq bucket + prefill/decode to selector context (Linear ENG-3924).
- Yuki to draft GPU normalization map + tests list (Linear ENG-3925).

------------------------------------------------------------
2026-01-14 (Tue) 10:00–11:00 PT
Attendees: Grace, Yuki, Omar, Lena, Hiro, Sofia, Marcus, Anika

Status
- ENG-3923 (selector core): initial implementation underway.
- ENG-3925 (GPU normalization): in progress, waiting on list of odd SKUs we see in fleet.
- ENG-3924 (seq buckets): Lena has a sketch for scheduler -> runtime signal.

Notes / discussion
- Determinism requirement: identical inputs should yield identical kernel choice (no perf noise due to tie-breaking). Plan: stable sort by (priority, expected_tok_s, kernel_id).
- Unknown model family behavior: default safe kernel set, plus emit a single warning counter (rate-limited) to avoid log spam.
- Conformance tests: Anika wants a “safe kernel allowlist” concept so CI can explicitly restrict which kernels can be selected in test mode.

PRs
- redwood/pr_18432_kernel_selector_v2_core opened (WIP).

Action items
- Grace: add a “selector explain path” structure internally even before we ship the debug endpoint (so it’s easy to add later).
- Anika: define minimal conformance suite shapes per model family + seq bucket (Linear ENG-3928).

------------------------------------------------------------
2026-01-21 (Tue) 10:00–11:00 PT
Attendees: Grace, Yuki, Omar, Lena, Hiro, Sofia, Logan, Thomas

Status
- redwood/pr_18441_model_family_detection_rules: ready for review (Noah + Grace).
- redwood/pr_18463_gpu_sku_normalization: drafted tests for L4/A10/A100/H100.

Telemetry/cardi review (Logan/Thomas)
- Proposed labels for kernel choice metric:
  - selector_version (v1/v2)
  - model_family (bucketed to top N; overflow “other/unknown”)
  - gpu_sku (L4/A10/A100/H100/other)
  - seq_bucket (S/M/L/XL; exact boundaries defined in code)
  - kernel_id (THIS is the risky one)
- Thomas: kernel_id as a metric label is too high-card; recommend log/trace annotation for kernel_id, and metric uses “kernel_group” (coarser) + top-k sampling.
- Decision: metrics use kernel_group; traces/logs include full kernel_id.

Decisions
- Adopt “bucket-first” seq_bucket naming and keep boundaries centralized (single source of truth). No copy-paste constants.

Action items
- Omar: ensure trace annotation includes selector inputs + decision summary (ties to ENG-3927).
- Thomas: provide final allowed label list + bucketing guidance (follow-up doc, but unblock PR).

------------------------------------------------------------
2026-01-28 (Tue) 10:00–11:00 PT
Attendees: Grace, Yuki, Omar, Lena, Hiro, Sofia, Marcus, Rina, Sahana

Status / PRs
- redwood/pr_18455_seq_length_bucket_signal_from_scheduler: open. Needs scheduler integration review (Sofia + Lena).
- redwood/pr_18472_kernel_registry_schema_v1: open. Includes initial table entries for Llama-family + Mistral-family placeholders.

Perf suite / CI gates (Sahana)
- perf-canary/pr_388_selector_v2_perf_gate drafted. Threshold question: do we gate on absolute p95 or delta vs baseline?
- Decision: gate on delta vs selector v1 baseline (same commit) for p95 latency and tok/s; also include an absolute crash/correctness gate.

Open issues
- Registry update process: who reviews/owns changes per model family? Hiro suggests runtime kernels team owns approvals; scheduling team is consulted for seq buckets.

Action items
- Marcus/Rina: list representative prompt distributions for benchmark-lab and tie them to seq buckets (ENG-3929).
- Grace: add registry schema notes for versioning and promotion (ENG-3926).

------------------------------------------------------------
2026-02-04 (Tue) 10:00–11:00 PT
Attendees: Grace, Yuki, Omar, Lena, Hiro, Sofia, Marcus, Anika, Aisha, Connor

Status / merges
- redwood/pr_18480_selector_v2_feature_flag_and_overrides: in review (Benji + Connor)
- redwood/pr_18493_selector_telemetry_metrics_and_traces: in review; needs label set finalization per Thomas.
- benchmark-lab/pr_941_selector_v2_benchmark_matrix: merged (Rina)

Rollout plan check (Aisha/Connor)
- Proposed rollout stages for runtime-1.19:
  1) internal canary (one region) + SRE monitors
  2) Hosted 5% in us-east
  3) Hosted 25% (expand to 2 regions)
  4) Dedicated opt-in
  5) default-on (Hosted)
- Need explicit rollback triggers: p95 regression > budget, error rate, or NaN/correctness signals.

Customer context
- SUP-8860: customer wants ability to pin/override kernel selection for Dedicated evaluation. This should be supported by overrides config + runbook.

Action items
- Connor: confirm how fast rollback can propagate (config push latency) and whether we need a kill switch separate from feature flag.
- Aisha: draft dashboard panels for selector version breakdown + kernel-choice heatmap (INT-2331).

------------------------------------------------------------
2026-02-11 (Tue) 10:00–11:15 PT
Attendees: Grace, Yuki, Omar, Lena, Hiro, Sofia, Sana, Aisha, Connor, Sahana

Canary readout (Sana)
- Internal canary: A10 shows p95 regression on long-context prompts (seq_bucket L/XL) for Mistral-family.
- L4 looks neutral to slightly better.
- A100/H100 look improved.
- Hypothesis: long-context path chooses kernel X that is fine on A100+ but worse on A10 due to SM / memory behavior. Potentially wrong table entry or GPU normalization edge.

Hot items
- Need a “why” debug tool now; manual digging through traces is slow. Align with ENG-3932.

Decisions
- Pause external 5% rollout until A10 long-context issue is understood.
- Add a temporary per-GPU override for A10 + Mistral-family long-context to force the prior known-good kernel (use override precedence rules; document in runbook).

Action items
- Yuki + Grace: isolate A10 perf issue with microbench + profile (blocker).
- Lena: confirm seq_bucket boundaries aren’t mis-classifying long contexts as XL prematurely.
- Sahana: update perf-canary to include A10 long-context distribution as a required lane before rollout.

References
- Customer ticket SUP-8841: L4 latency regression report after runtime upgrade (not confirmed selector-related yet). Track separately but keep eyes open.

------------------------------------------------------------
2026-02-13 (Thu) async notes (from Slack + email)
- Exec update went out re: canary regression + mitigation/rollback plan (Mateo/Ava/Connor). We’re expected to have a clear diff + fix before we reattempt 5%.

------------------------------------------------------------
2026-02-18 (Tue) 10:00–11:10 PT
Attendees: Grace, Yuki, Omar, Lena, Hiro, Sofia, Anika, Sana, Thomas

What happened / findings
- Confirmed bug: seq bucket boundary off-by-one causing some prompts to land in XL bucket earlier than intended; selector table for XL on A10 pointed to a kernel that regressed.
- Fix in progress: redwood/pr_18571_fix_seq_bucket_off_by_one.
- Also saw a rare crash path for unknown model family fallback (null family id in one codepath). Hotfix queued: redwood/pr_18526_fix_unknown_model_family_fallback_bug.

Correctness
- SUP-8874 mentions sporadic NaNs suspected to correlate with kernel choice. We don’t have a clean repro yet. Anika: add NaN guards and expand conformance shapes around long-context prefill.

Telemetry follow-up (Thomas)
- Metric cardinality: initial kernel_choice metric still too high due to kernel_group explosion from experimental kernel variants.
- Plan: restrict kernel_group to a curated set per selector version, and emit “other” for everything else. Full fidelity stays in traces.
- Tracking: redwood/pr_18519_reduce_metric_cardinality_for_kernel_choice.

Action items
- Omar: ensure unknown model family fallback increments a counter with rate-limited logs (so we can discover new families without flooding).
- Anika: add NaN detection + seed-stable prompts for long-context conformance (ENG-3928).

------------------------------------------------------------
2026-02-20 (Fri) 15:00–15:30 PT (rollout prep mini-sync)
Attendees: Grace, Connor, Aisha, Sana

Rollout checklist items to close
- Confirm dashboards include selector_version breakdown by GPU SKU and region.
- Confirm rollback mechanism tested in staging (time-to-disable).
- Confirm perf-canary lanes green after seq_bucket fix.

Next steps
- If PRs 18571 + 18519 + 18526 land by Monday, re-run benchmark sweep (A10 emphasized) and target 5% Hosted canary mid-week.

------------------------------------------------------------
Parking lot / open questions (keep updated)
- Registry ownership: do we require 2 approvers for registry changes? (suggest: 1 kernel team + 1 perf/benchmark owner)
- Model family expansion: Qwen-family and other emerging arch flags (GQA nuances). Track additions via registry PRs.
- How to represent “effective context length” under prefix caching (do we bucket on total tokens or uncached tokens?). Needs alignment with scheduling instrumentation.

Quick index (what to check when something goes wrong)
- Linear project: ENG-3921
- Core logic PR: redwood/pr_18432_kernel_selector_v2_core
- Seq bucket plumbing: redwood/pr_18455_seq_length_bucket_signal_from_scheduler
- GPU normalization: redwood/pr_18463_gpu_sku_normalization
- Telemetry: redwood/pr_18493_selector_telemetry_metrics_and_traces
- Perf gate: perf-canary/pr_388_selector_v2_perf_gate
- Benchmark matrix: benchmark-lab/pr_941_selector_v2_benchmark_matrix

Owner note (Grace): Keep this doc messy/fast. If something becomes “real policy” (rollout guardrails, telemetry standards, registry governance), move it to Confluence + link back here.
